settings.title: Settings
settings.geminiModelHint: gemini-flash-latest always points to the newest Flash release (avoids deprecations). Alternatives: {alt1}, {alt2}, or {alt3} (closes 2026-07-22).
settings.localAiTitle: 🔒 Local AI (offline-first — zero network, zero data leak)
settings.localAiHint: If configured below, the local AI is ALWAYS tried first, before Gemini/Groq/backend — the prompt and response never leave the device (WebGPU) or the local network (server).
settings.localServerModel: Model name on the local server
settings.webgpuHint: First load: ~1-5 GB download (cached by the browser via IndexedDB — instant afterwards). Requires Chrome/Edge 113+ (desktop or recent Android); not available on Safari/Firefox yet. Once loaded, no network request is made to generate a reply.
settings.offlineCertifiedHint: Forces pre-computed answers, even if an AI key is configured. No network call to Gemini/Groq.
